task_shape: one paragraph + its own shuffled reference pool (fixed at 3 references per unit); recover citation order
submission_shape: one row per unit: unit_id, rank_A, rank_B, rank_C (each an integer in 0..2, the true reading position of that lettered card)
split_note: split by ARTICLE, not paragraph, so no two paragraphs from the same source article cross train/test
